Inyo County runs the length of the Owens Valley between the Sierra crest and Death Valley, with Bishop as its commercial center and Independence as its seat. The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power owns most of the valley floor, so private land is scarce and tightly held, and tourism, federal land management, and water-export politics govern nearly every development question here.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 27, 2026
